_about: Public-domain William Bernard Ullathorne (1806-1889, Benedictine, first Bishop of Birmingham) for the Word Hoard: 5 books from Internet Archive scans: his trilogy The Endowments of Man (1880), The Groundwork of the Christian Virtues (1882) and Christian Patience (1886), and the Autobiography and the Letters, whose title pages carry no year (their prefaces are dated 1891 and 1892). Written in English. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ullathorne-endowments-of-man: The Endowments of Man considered in their relations with his final end (London: Burns & Oates, 1880)
ullathorne-groundwork-virtues: The Groundwork of the Christian Virtues (London: Burns and Oates, 1882)
ullathorne-christian-patience: Christian Patience, the Strength and Discipline of the Soul (London: Burns and Oates, 1886)
ullathorne-autobiography: The Autobiography of Archbishop Ullathorne, with selections from his letters (London: Burns & Oates; no year on the title page, preface dated 1891)
ullathorne-letters: Letters of Archbishop Ullathorne (London: Burns & Oates; New York: Catholic Publication Society; no year on the title page, preface dated 1892)
